# Cargo One

> Cargo One is a UK logistics marketplace that connects customers with verified drivers to move almost anything, from a single parcel to a car, a pallet or a house move. Customers get an instant price, book online, follow their driver on a live map and receive photo proof of delivery.

Website: https://cargoone.co.uk
Area served: United Kingdom
Availability: open 24/7, 365 days a year

## How it works
- Enter pickup, drop-off and what you're moving to get an instant price.
- A verified driver accepts the job, and you can see who's coming.
- Track the driver live on the map and receive photo proof of delivery.

## Ways to book
- ASAP: the job is offered straight away to nearby drivers who are online. Used for urgent jobs, including 24/7 vehicle recovery.
- Scheduled: choose a date and time. Jobs can be posted for driver bids or at a fixed price.
